annotations.title: Decode an EVM transaction: method, events, transfers

description: Decoded EVM transaction on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon or Avalanche: status, block time, sender, target, value and fee in native coin and USD (current price), method and arguments, decoded events, ERC-20/721 token transfers, net token flows per address and a one-line summary. ABIs from Sourcify verified contracts or the Sourcify 4byte database. Ethereum receipts cover about the last 2 days. Sources: PublicNode and official chain JSON-RPC, Uniswap v3 pools. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

chain.description: Chain by name, alias or chain id: base (8453), ethereum (1), arbitrum (42161), optimism (10), polygon (137), avalanche (43114).
